observations: Service/consultancy body-shops and staffing intermediaries filtered out per the recorded deal-breaker: Accenture (x3 postings), getinz-people (x2, staffing-pattern naming no end client), CodeRound AI (explicit placement agency for an undisclosed client), and four jobgether-branded postings that never name the real employer.

Roku posted 8 distinct backend openings and 6 distinct ML/AI openings in Bengaluru this run (titles differ by team, e.g. Ads Engineering, Data, Recommendations - not a mass-posting repeat of one description). Consolidated a near-identical generic 'Senior Backend Engineer' repost (3 near-duplicate title variants) down to one row.

Seniority inflation continues: of the High-fit postings detail-checked, only Visa (3-6 years) states a band matching current experience exactly. Addepar wants 10+ years plus team leadership; Citi wants 8-11 years; Payoneer/PayPay/tekion want 6-10 years; Guidewire/Cisco want 5-8/5-10 years.

The two-track equal-weighting continues to surface strong candidates on both axes: several fintech names appeared this run (Citi, JPMorganChase, Visa, Payoneer, PayPay India, Addepar), consistent with the Priority 2 fintech-transfer thesis from the Deutsche Bank background.
